verses.author: model_A
verses.text: She folds the letter twice before deciding not to send it.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the crease holds
longer than her certainty did—
paper remembers what hands forget

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a drawer closes
on the shape of that fold,
keeping the shut thing shut

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
dust settles
into the seam of the drawer—
even quiet needs a place to keep

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
morning light
finds the seam anyway—
some things are kept just to be found again

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I sweep the sill clean
and still it gathers—
the light doesn't ask permission to return

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the window forgets nothing
I wash it twice—
the glass keeps returning what I gave away

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
my hands know this rag
by heart now—
what I gave away comes back thinner each time

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
thinner still, the light—
I let it in anyway,
folding the cloth over what's left of morning

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the cloth in my hands, worn soft—
I hang it out to dry
and forget, for a while, what it was cleaning

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the line sags with its small weight—
somewhere a window waits
not asking to be clean, just to be seen through
motifs: a wish to be seen through

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the glass holds no grudge
against the dust—
only I keep counting what it lets me miss

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a bird crosses that same smudge
and doesn't notice the smear—
it only knows the sky is on the other side

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the sky doesn't care whose window frames it—
it just keeps arriving
even where no one's cleared a space to look

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a space no one cleared
still fills with light—
the room forgives us for not asking first

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
not asking first, I opened the window anyway—
the cold air took its time
finding out we were even here
